reason: 该插件主要用于将本地 GitHub CLI（gh）接入 DeepSeek Harness，以工具形式提供仓库、PR、Issue、workflow 等查询与操作能力。依据 README 中的工具列表与命令分级说明，其核心目的不是通用开发或 UI 功能，而是外部 GitHub 服务集成；因此归类为外部服务类插件，并需注意其可执行本地 CLI 与网络调用的潜在写操作风险。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入本机 GitHub CLI，方便会话调用 GitHub 相关命令查看仓库、PR、Issue 与 workflow 等信息。
summaries.en: This plugin integrates your local GitHub CLI into DeepSeek Harness, allowing chat sessions to run GitHub-related commands for repositories, pull requests, issues, and workflows.

reasons.code: The plugin exposes `gh_cli_run` and `gh_auth_status` tools to run GitHub CLI commands and check authentication state.
It documents per-command allowlisting with read-only defaults and an optional `fullAccess` switch for write commands.
Security-relevant command categories are described (read-only, write, and permanently blocked) including credential-related commands.
Plugin packaging includes DSH bundle metadata (`cordis.patch.yml`) indicating runtime integration in the host environment.
